//roots: Folders you already have. init links these into vaults/<key>. Nothing is moved or copied. Use ~ for your home directory and forward slashes on every platform.
//loose: One-off project folders that live outside the roots above. Linked into vaults/loose/<key>.
//departments: Rename, add and delete freely. id must be lowercase and filename-safe. type is one of: core (in use), tool (external connector), gap (does not exist yet). Gaps are the point: they are what the atlas draws in gold and what /review nags you about.

departments.name: Growth
departments.mission: Turn what you learn into things people find, and turn those people into an audience.
departments.note: Replace this with the two or three facts a session keeps needing. Keep it short: this text is shown in the atlas and read at the start of every brief.

items.label: trend-scan
items.desc: Whatever you use to find out what people are actually talking about.

items.label: web-search
items.desc: An MCP connector for search and page extraction.

items.label: draft
items.desc: The skill that writes the thing.

items.label: post-retro
items.desc: Nothing records how a piece performed after it shipped, so the loop never closes.

items.label: queue
items.desc: Ideas to queued to shipped, append-style.

departments.name: Product
departments.mission: Ship and keep alive the things that charge money directly.
departments.note: Name the repos that actually make money here, and the one analytics event chain that tells you whether they do.

items.label: github
items.desc: Repos, pull requests, issues, code search.

items.label: incident-log
items.desc: Nothing records what broke, when, or what fixed it, so every outage is diagnosed from scratch.

departments.name: Revenue
departments.mission: Convert attention into money, and know which part of the path is doing the converting.
departments.note: The funnel as it actually runs, including the step you cannot measure. Naming the blind spot is more useful than pretending it is not there.

items.label: money-map
items.desc: One file describing the funnel and the offers. Ground every pricing answer here.

items.label: pricing-test
items.desc: No structured pricing experiment has been run.

departments.name: Memory
departments.mission: Hold what the other departments need to remember, and hand it back on demand.
departments.note: This ledger records changes to how the vault is organised, not the content going into it.

items.label: search-scoping
items.desc: The order a session searches in. This discipline is why exact search keeps working as the vault grows.

items.label: obsidian
items.desc: Reads and writes the vault directly.

items.label: weekly-digest
items.desc: Nothing summarises what the vault learned this week.

//mcp: Copied verbatim into a generated .mcp.json at the org root, so a session started here has every connector. Leave empty to skip generating the file.
